title: ProductDefinitionLifecycleEvent
description: Base schema for all Product Definition lifecycle events on the product-definition.lifecycle topic. Message key is the definitionId to preserve per-definition ordering.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this event instance. Used for deduplication.

eventType.description: Discriminated event type. Consumers filter on this field.

aggregateId.description: The Product Definition identifier this event belongs to. Also used as the Kafka message key.

versionId.description: The specific version affected by this event.

version.description: Monotonically increasing event sequence number for this aggregate.

lifecycleState.description: The lifecycle state AFTER this event was applied.

previousLifecycleState.description: The lifecycle state BEFORE this event was applied. Absent for created events.

actorId.description: User ID or service account ID that triggered the event.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with UTC offset when the event occurred.

correlationId.description: Traces the originating HTTP request or command across services.

causationId.description: ID of the event that caused this event. Set when this event results from another event.

tenantId.description: Tenant scoping identifier. Required for multi-tenant deployments.

metadata.description: Optional event-type-specific payload. See per-event schemas for field definitions.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the uploaded file content.

rejectionReason.description: Human-readable rejection reason. Present on rejected events.

rollbackFromVersionId.description: The version that was displaced by rollback. Present on rolled_back events.

restoredVersionId.description: The version restored as published by rollback. Present on rolled_back events.

publishValidationGatesPassed.description: List of publish validation gate names that passed. Present on approved/published events.
